agent_runs_paid_requires_decision.name: agent_runs_paid_requires_decision
agent_runs_paid_requires_decision.value: billing_mode NOT IN ('usage_credits', 'api_billing') OR paid_usage_decision_id IS NOT NULL

decision_requests_resolved_has_time.name: decision_requests_resolved_has_time
decision_requests_resolved_has_time.value: status NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR resolved_at IS NOT NULL

evidence_linked_kinds_have_ref.name: evidence_linked_kinds_have_ref
evidence_linked_kinds_have_ref.value: kind NOT IN ('verification_run', 'review') OR ref IS NOT NULL

roadmap_updates_applied_needs_dry_run.name: roadmap_updates_applied_needs_dry_run
roadmap_updates_applied_needs_dry_run.value: status <> 'applied' OR (applied_at IS NOT NULL AND dry_run_diff IS NOT NULL AND dry_run_at IS NOT NULL)

roadmap_updates_applying_has_attempt.name: roadmap_updates_applying_has_attempt
roadmap_updates_applying_has_attempt.value: status <> 'applying' OR (apply_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND apply_started_at IS NOT NULL)

task_suggestions_source_ref_present.name: task_suggestions_source_ref_present
task_suggestions_source_ref_present.value: source_type IN ('human', 'agent') OR source_ref IS NOT NULL

validation_leases_digest_valid.name: validation_leases_digest_valid
validation_leases_digest_valid.value:
length(token_hash) = 64 AND token_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(authority_artifact_digest) = 64 AND authority_artifact_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(authority_validation_nonce) = 36 AND authority_validation_nonce NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f-]*'
      AND length(release_manifest_hash) = 64 AND release_manifest_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(release_tree_hash) = 64 AND release_tree_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(project_identity_hash) = 64 AND project_identity_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(project_root_hash) = 64 AND project_root_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(request_digest) = 64 AND request_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      AND length(expected_evidence_hash) = 64 AND expected_evidence_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
